summary: This project is aimed at the general public, allowing anyone to explore the conditions at a lunar landing site via a website a resource that could also be useful for those planning their own lunar expedition. It was developed to address the challenge that calculating all the probabilities for a specific landing site can often be highly inefficient.
details: Our project is a website that has the potential to significantly impact how the conditions of a lunar landing are visualized. Built using HTML, the site incorporates creative elements to make the experience interactive and engaging for users. Naturally, we took into account various technical factors such as calculations regarding the sun’s angle in relation to the moon and Earth, as well as topographical data provided by NASA all of which were essential to the completion of this project.
